name: Fourier GR-2
summary: GR-2 is Fourier's second-generation general humanoid, 175 cm and 63 kg with 53 DoF including 12-DoF hands. It is aimed at research and development teams and supports ROS, NVIDIA Isaac Lab and MuJoCo.
hands: 12-DoF dexterous hands with six array-type tactile sensors.
sensors: Six array-type tactile sensors per hand.
highlights: FSA 2.0 actuators with peak torque above 380 N·m.
Detachable battery with twice the capacity of GR-1.
caveats: Speed and compute are not stated in the launch coverage.

sources.title: Fourier launches GR-2 humanoid, software platform
Fourier's new GR-2 robot displays human-like motion and flexibility
